data_fields.name: leash_fail_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 12 consecutive failed catch-up moves (drop when more than 12)

data_fields.name: follow_tier_far_units
data_fields.donor_constant: 12 coordinate units (subtile_coord(12,0)); speed max(2x leader, 5/4 follower)

data_fields.name: member_countdown
data_fields.donor_constant: per-member turns before first action (script value)

best_idea: Leader succession by a ranked rule (preferred role, then defenders last, then level, then score) on every removal, with followers falling back to idle when the leader is gone and dropping out after 12 failed catch-ups.
decision_why: The ranked succession, idle fallback and leash drop-out fit the engine-owned attacker group; the dungeon roles (digger, job rooms) do not, and the donor's role class is last-wins (creature_groups.c:335), so take the shape and fix the defect.
acceptance: In a 3-attacker server test, when the leader dies the next leader is the highest-level survivor (ties by score); a follower with 13 consecutive failed catch-up moves leaves the group on its next tick and goes idle; one successful move resets its fail count.
